book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: APOCALIPSIS Apóstol Juanta Tayta Diosninsi ricasishgancuna

content: Röllucho ganchis cag lagaraycag cërata Jesucristo jorgushgan
Röllucho ganchis cag lagaraycag cërata Jesucristo jorguriptinmi gloriacho media hörano pipis parlacorgansu.
Nircurnami ricargä Tayta Diospa naupancho ganchis angilcuna ichiraycäyagta. Paycunami cada ünun cornëtata chasquiyargan tucananpä.

Saypitana juc ángil shamorgan goripita rurash incienso goshnisicunan aptash. Paymi Tayta Diospa trönun naupancho cag goripita rurash altarman chargan. Sayman chaycuptinmi Tayta Diosninsi asca inciensuta puestupargan altarcho goshnisinanpä. Say inciensuta ángil goshnisiptinmi Tayta Diospa trönunman goshtay juntargan. Say goshtaywan talushmi caycargan Diosman yäracogcuna manacuyashgancunapis.

Nircurna incienso goshnisicunanman say ángil winargan altarcho caycag shanshata. Nircurmi say incienso goshnisicunanta cay pasaman jitaramorgan. Say jitamushgan chämuptinmi asicyaypa asicyar elgucuy cargan. Magacuypis bunruruypa bunrurur wiyacargan. Saynömi pasapis fiyupa sucsucyargan.
Saypitanami cornëtata chasqueg ganchis angilcuna alistacuyargan tucayänanpä.

Punta cag ángil cornëtata tucamuptinmi ninawan yawar talush runtu tamya cay pasaman tamyamorgan. Saywanmi cäsi pulan pasa rupar ushacäyargan. Say runtu tamya chashgan cäga jachapis y guewapis lapanmi ushacargan.
Saypita ishcay cag ángil cornëtata tucamuptinmi jatuncaray jircano rupaycar lamarman jegamorgan. Saymi cäsi pulan lamar yawarman ticrargan.
Yawarman ticrashgan cagchöga lapanmi wanuyargan y lapan barcucunapis talpucar ushacäyargan.
Quimsa cag ángil cornëtata tucamuptinmi jatuncaray rupaycag goyllar jegamorgan. Say goyllarga cäsi pulan mayucunaman y cäsi pulan pucyucunamanmi chargan.
Say goyllarpa jutinmi cargan Ayag. Ayag captinmi say goyllar chashgan cag yacoga ayag ricacorgan. Saymi say yacuta upur asca runacuna wanuyargan.
Chuscu cag ángil cornëtata tucamuptinmi intipis y quilapis gueshyargan. Saynölami waquin goyllarcunapis chipipiyargannasu. Saymi intipis, quilapis y goyllarcunapis shumag asicyäyargannasu.

Saypitanami ricargä juc condur-nirag junagpa tumaycagta. Say hörami wiyargä say condur-nirag cayno nimogta: “¡Walärä! ¡Cay pasacho cawagcuna imanörä cayanga guepa cag quimsan angilcuna sararaycäyashgan cornëtata tucayämuptin!”
